---
id: fixture-02
title: Welding repair on a pipe support near process piping
---
| # | Step | Hazards | Controls |
|---|------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Issue hot work permit | Work starts without area authority approval | Permit signed by area authority and issuing officer |
| 2 | Prepare the work area | Combustible material near the work; sparks falling to lower decks | Combustibles removed; fire blankets placed over openings and drains |
| 3 | Weld the pipe support | Burns; welding fumes; eye injury from arc | Welding PPE; fume extraction; welding screens |
| 4 | Cool down and close out | Smouldering material after work stops | Fire watch for 30 minutes after work; permit closed with area authority |
